summary: The filing is an 8-K dated July 20, 2026, in which Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. (OTC:AITX) furnishes a press release under Item 8.01. The press release announces that its subsidiary, Robotic Assistance Devices, received an expansion order for five RIO 360 autonomous solar-powered security trailers from a global logistics customer. This is a routine business development and customer order announcement, not a special situation event. No financial terms, transaction structure, or strategic actions such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes are disclosed.
